patch.summary: Freshsales migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Freshsales by inventorying legacy crm fields, mapping them to Freshsales objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Gmail before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Sales sequences, contact scoring, and territory management start on Pro; forecasting insights, custom modules, sandbox, and audit logs are Enterprise.
Success signal: contact management works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Freshsales migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power contact management, lead management, pipeline management and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Freshsales; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Gmail; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when SMB and mid-market teams wanting CRM + phone/email engagement outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Sales sequences, contact scoring, and territory management start on Pro; forecasting insights, custom modules, sandbox, and audit logs are Enterprise.
If Freshsales mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Pipedrive before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Gmail in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Sales sequences, contact scoring, and territory management start on Pro; forecasting insights, custom modules, sandbox, and audit logs are Enterprise.

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Branded documents (list price) and Freddy AI Agent (list price/100 sessions) are listed as paid add-ons.

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: SEO copy mentions a free plan, but the live pricing cards researched Aug 2026 list Growth/Pro/Enterprise only starting at list price — treat free forever as unverified from plan cards.

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for contact management
Mitigate: Sales sequences, contact scoring, and territory management start on Pro; forecasting insights, custom modules, sandbox, and audit logs are Enterprise.

notes: Migration: cutover risks, data mapping, checklist.
